title: Set SEO details and a favicon
blurb: Control how your page shows up in Google, on social media and in the browser tab.

steps.title: Open the page
steps.body: Open your funnel, pick the step and click **Edit** to open the builder.

steps.title: Open SEO settings
steps.body: In the builder, open **Settings** and choose **SEO Meta Data**.

steps.title: Fill in the details
steps.body: Add a **Title** (about 60 characters, include your service and town), a **Description** (one or two sentences that make people click) and a **Social Image** for when the link is shared.
steps.tip: Example title: Heat Pump Installs Hamilton | Your Business

steps.title: Save and publish
steps.body: Click **Save**, then **Publish** so search engines can see the new details.

steps.title: Add a favicon
steps.body: The favicon is the tiny logo in the browser tab. Go back to the funnel, open its **Settings** tab and add your favicon image, then save.
steps.tip: Use a square logo, at least 32 by 32 pixels, on a plain background.
